title: Create immutable ETF history-pack v1.1 with recovered malformed rows and explicit non-session semantics
allowed_change_scope: tests/research/** directly related ETF history-pack v1.1 validation only
forbidden_changes: delete or mutate v1 pack bytes
objective: Preserve the existing v1 ETF history pack byte-for-byte and create a superseding v1.1 research pack that repairs the 11 one-cell-short rows from the exact original exports and makes NYSE full-closure rows explicit non-sessions. The v1.1 builder must retain raw rows but must not count closure rows as trading sessions in N-session windows/streaks. Do not silently rewrite v1, infer publication/finality time, or change live ETF owner semantics.
reproduction: E1X D01 reproduced 11 malformed rows (9 BTC, 2 ETH) and 26 all-zero NYSE-closure rows. The exact original exports have now been recovered from the user's project Library and independently hash-bound: Etf btc.md = 114272 bytes, SHA-256 73ffcff5660b34a55605121c809205b2ba341a9b822bc4047efc61a995cb91fb, 651 rows; ETF eth.md = 77110 bytes, SHA-256 ac623c0bdd72213851dae67798aa461a4e3ea7e4fdea13abd4b54545edb7ed72, 513 rows. The 11 exact source rows are frozen in recovery_evidence below so implementation does not require Library access.

evidence.summary: E1X D01 owner issue with reproduced malformed/non-session counts and source recovery update.
Immutable v1 pack to preserve; three affected partitions are structurally corrupt while three clean partitions match their manifests.
Durable research finding. Keep historical v1 finding intact after v1.1 is created.

recovery_evidence.non_session_evidence: Use the 26 exact rows already reproduced in issue #1212 / E1X D01 and verify each against a deterministic US exchange closure calendar. Preserve rows; flag them as non-session rather than deleting them.

positive: Every v1 file remains byte-identical to pre-fix main.
v1.1 contains the same row coverage/counts as v1 but all rows have the declared schema width and Total reconciles at one-decimal precision.
The 11 repaired rows match recovery_evidence exactly.
Exactly the reproduced exchange-closure rows are flagged non-session; real trading-session zero-flow rows remain trading sessions.
N-session rolling sums/counts/streaks are computed over trading sessions only and a closure row neither increments a session window nor resets a signed streak.
v1.1 manifest/checksums bind all new source/data/script artifacts and pass deterministic readback.
negative: Do not delete or modify any v1 artifact.
Do not use the known-corrupt 2026-07-06 BTC raw CSV as source authority.
Do not infer ETF publication/finality timestamps or resolve #1211/F04 in this task.
Do not change live ETF owner schema/finality logic, market thresholds, portfolio rules or any workflow.

clean_noop_condition: Stop if a fresh-main v1.1 superseding pack already exists with the same source hashes, 11 repaired rows and explicit non-session handling.
stop_condition: Stop without changes if the source hashes or frozen recovery rows conflict with fresh evidence, if the repair requires changing v1 bytes, or if a current owner already implements the same v1.1 supersession.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if the repair would require publication/finality semantics, market signal changes or a choice other than preserving v1 and creating a research-only v1.1 supersession.
persistence_note: Submitted after independent recovery of both original source exports and exact hash verification. Only the existing Codex intake controller may declare CODEX_READY.
